description.value:
Trigger The vaultline retreats.

Effect Each creature in the area attempts a @Check[will|dc:30|options:area-effect,inflicts:stunned,inflicts:stupefied] save with the following effects. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 2} and stupefied 1 for an indefinite duration.

stealth.details: to see the ley line energy retreating throughout the cavern

details.description: The retreating vaultline causes a series of cave-ins.
details.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:31], @Check[nature|dc:31], @Check[occultism|dc:31], or @Check[religion|dc:31] (master) to disperse the ley line's power as it retreats, or @Check[survival|dc:27] (expert) to predict where rubble might fall next. The DC of the flat check for this round (see Routine) is increased by 4 on a success or by 8 on a critical success. Increasing the flat check DC to 21 or higher stabilizes the cavern, ending the hazard.
details.reset: After 4 rounds, the hazard ends automatically as the vaultquake subsides.
details.routine: (1 action) The GM rolls a @Check[flat|dc:9] to determine if a cave-in occurs. On a successful check, falling rubble deals @Damage[(2d12+15)[bludgeoning]] damage to a random PC (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). On a critical success, the collapse deals @Damage[(2d12+15)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to all the PCs instead.
